 LoL Worlds 2026 — Gen.G Ruler Reveals Secrets Behind Hanwha Life Win
 Oct 24, 2026 5:09 PM PDT 
 Riot Games Flickr. 
 At the 2026 LoL World Championship Swiss Stage, LoL Worlds 2026 standout Park ‘Ruler’ Jae-hyuk of Gen.G revealed that thorough preparation was the key to their dominant victory over Hanwha Life Esports.
 Gen.G secured a 2-0 record in the Swiss stage by defeating Hanwha Life with a 22-7 kill score in just 29 minutes during their 2nd-round matchup. Following the match, Ruler shared insights into their preparation process, stating that they analyzed Hanwha Life extensively just as they would for a finals match.
 Metagame Analysis and Team Performance
 Despite the decisive victory, Ruler maintained a cautious stance regarding the team’s current form and meta adaptation. He noted that while Gen.G’s overall performance is gradually improving, their understanding of the current patch is not yet absolute. He emphasized that deeper analysis of champion strengths and weaknesses remains necessary as the tournament progresses.
 Desired Matchups and Message to CoreJJ
 Looking ahead at the tournament, Ruler expressed a humorous yet affectionate desire to face specific players, including his former teammate Jo ‘CoreJJ’ Yong-in. He shared that he spoke with CoreJJ the night before and felt a sense of empathy for the heavy workload and pressure his friend was experiencing, offering sincere words of encouragement for his future matches.
